method_summary: Two-sided Wronskian: interior regular Frobenius power seed (r^s, s=1.00168) outward-integrated; exterior INCOMING acoustic branch (mu=-2.01602 w, alpha=-1.07274) inward-integrated from r_seed=59.5; both forward-stable. D(w) = (psi_in' psi_ex - psi_ex' psi_in)/scale.
